manual_reason: Supersedes v1 after overlay review: the middle east pick lay beside the drawn face. All four faces now use brightness-edge refinement; the north arrow remains a manual tail-to-tip measurement.

lines.identification: Bisht 1998-99, Puratattva 29, PDF p.47/printed p.33, Fig.1: drawn wall face of solid black Harappan Defences exposure beside the post-Harappan structures label; labelled later houses are excluded.

Same Fig.1: short eastern face of southern solid-black Harappan Defences exposure, before the gap. Earlier extension along the moat-side line is excluded.

revision_note: v3 uses enlarged fresh 600 dpi checks. Earlier middle and south lines ran beyond individual solid-black exposures and are superseded. Only the black defence face is retained. Two faces of the same acropolis wall are correlated and do not represent independent buildings.
